sources.summary: Ecuadorian studio Caá Porá Arquitectura has worked with the local community to construct a pavilion in the Amazon rainforest that allows researchers to get a new perspective of the landscape in Pacto Sumaco, Ecuador. Known as the WildSumaco Research Pavilion, the facility was commissioned by Francis Marion University to expand the American institution's research operations The post Caá Porá Arquitectura creates teaching pavilion in the Amazon rainforest appeared first on Dezeen .
